gitCommit.subject: chore(test): upgrade vitest 1.6.1 → 4.1.9 (#229)
gitCommit.body:
chore(test): upgrade vitest 1.6.1 → 4.1.9 (#229)

* chore(test): upgrade vitest 1.6.1 -> 4.1.9

Spike-verified Medium/mechanical migration. One root cause: vitest 4 changed
mock-factory hoisting so vi.fn(() => repoVar)/mockImplementation(() => repoVar)
(closing over vi.hoisted vars) yields an arrow that can't be `new`'d. Codemod:
arrow -> function expression in vi.fn/mockImplementation factories across the
test suite (behaviorally identical for value returns; constructible for the repo/
service constructor mocks). Pin CI node 20 -> 22 (v4 needs >=20.19/22.12).

Unit 558 pass + DB integration 136 pass on v4; lint/tsc/build green. Native
--mergeReports now available (supersedes the planned istanbul merge for coverage
Phase 0).

Bead: vitest-upgrade

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* chore(test): pin Node >=22.12 (engines + .nvmrc) to match vitest 4 + CI

Folds the upgrade-review minor: converge CI/local/Vercel on Node 22 (vitest 4 +
vite 7 floor). Note for the coverage PR: v4's default 'forks' pool + AST-aware v8
remapping mean coverage is re-baselined on v4 (Phase 0 computes it fresh).
